channel.title: The Local Europe - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Local Europe (thelocal.com)

item.title: Switzerland announces June date for referendum on anti-immigration proposal
item.description: The Swiss government has decided to bring the right-wing initiative seeking to curb immigration to the ballot box on June 14th.

item.title: Inside France: Rain, political street battles and De Gaulle
item.description: From the death of far right activist Quentin and the consequences for France's 'republican front' at election times, via the endless rain and the multiplying De Gaulle memes, Inside France is our weekly look at the latest news and talking points from France.

item.title: Inside Spain: Does Japan have the solution to Spaniards' longevity problem?
item.description: In this week’s edition we explain why Spain is looking at Japan's healthcare system as an example of what to do when your country has the highest life expectancy in the world.

item.title: Macron urges 'calm' ahead of tense rally for slain far-right activist
item.description: French President Emmanuel Macron appealed on Saturday for cooler heads to prevail ahead of a rally for a far-right activist whose killing, blamed on the hard left, has put the country on edge.

item.title: Trump tariffs ruling a 'strong signal' for trade rules, says German business
item.description: A US Supreme Court ruling that sweeping tariffs imposed by US President Donald Trump are illegal is a "strong signal for the rules-based trading system", German industry group BDI said Friday.

item.title: OPINION: Macron's offer to 'extend' the French nuclear umbrella to Europe is fraught with problems
item.description: Sharing umbrellas is never easy. France has offered to 'extend' its nuclear umbrella to other European countries without actually 'sharing' it. How can that work, asks John Lichfield.

item.title: What is the 'cold line' in Austria and how you can use it to save lives
item.description: Two men have died in Vienna after exposure to freezing temperatures. Caritas says the cases show why using Austria’s winter cold lines can be crucial.

item.title: UK’s new passport rules for dual citizens are result of border control in digital age
item.description: New passport rules for British dual citizens reflect border control and citizenship in a digital age, writes Nando Sigona in The Conversation.

item.title: LISTED: The new direct flights you can catch from Munich in 2026
item.description: New direct international flights are set to launch from Munich Airport this year, offering residents and visitors in Germany more options than ever for travel across Europe, the Middle East and beyond.

item.title: Activists hang UK ex-prince's arrest photo in the Louvre
item.description: Activists managed to temporarily hang a new picture in Paris' Louvre - the arrest photo of UK royal family member Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor.
